snippet.title: Card Conquest - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Card Conquest is a Tower Defense game with Deckbuilding and Roguelite elements. Combine spells, towers and units to create a deck and defeat your enemies. Spend your resources wisely and find balance between offense and defense. Gather powerful relics that will enhance your cards.

Releasing 25 September 2026 on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3883580/Card_Conquest/

#indiegame #games #gaming #towerdefense
